description:
Configure the 'Sidebar' region of the store to display specific tools for logged-in customers while keeping the checkout process distraction-free.

1. Create a Custom Block named 'Sidebar Support' with the text 'Need help? Call 555-0199'.
2. Go to the Block Layout (Structure > Block Layout) and place the following three blocks in the 'Sidebar' region:
   - User account menu
   - Shopping Cart
   - The 'Sidebar Support' block you just created
3. Configure Visibility for ALL THREE blocks:
   - Roles: Visible ONLY to 'Authenticated user'
   - Pages: Hide on pages starting with '/checkout/*' (Select 'Hide for the listed pages' and enter '/checkout/*')

Ensure you save the block layout configurations.
